note: Merged/ready real issue fixing cli-args.mts's own flag-disambiguation logic; today's A4 clear_verification criterion and A4.5 verifiability check both false-positive on its own flag-parsing meta prose (known lexical-gate boundary gap).
title: fix(cli-args): reserve a declared flag's own alias before single-dash disambiguation
body:
## Bug Overview

`cli-args.mts`'s shared `parseCliArgs()` wrapper's generic single-dash
disambiguation (`disambiguateSingleDashValues`) rewrites `--flag -X`
into `--flag=-X` for **any** declared `string`-type flag whenever the
following token starts with a single dash — including when that
following token is itself the flag's own declared short alias (e.g.
`-h` for `--help`). This means `-h` immediately after any string flag
is silently consumed as that flag's literal value instead of being
recognized as `--help`, on every `idd-*` helper already migrated onto
this wrapper (`#1466`/`#1467`), not just one.

Found during #1955's review (chatgpt-codex-connector), which flagged
this exact pattern on `rerun-advisory-convergence.mts`'s `--check-name`
flag. Confirmed empirically that the pre-migration native
`node:util.parseArgs` call threw `ERR_PARSE_ARGS_INVALID_OPTION_VALUE`
("ambiguous") for the same input, so this is a real (if narrow)
regression from adopting the shared wrapper — but it is **systemic to
the wrapper itself**, already present on every other already-migrated
helper's string flags (verified against `branch-name.mts`'s `--title`,
unrelated to #1955's diff), not something #1955 introduced or could
fix within its own narrow single-helper scope.

## Expected Behavior

A declared flag's own short/long alias (e.g. `-h`/`--help`) should
never be silently consumed as a preceding string flag's value.
`node bin/idd-branch-name.mjs --title -h --number 5` (or any other
already-migrated helper's equivalent) should either show help or fail
with a clear parse error, not silently resolve `--title` to the
literal string `"-h"`.

## Steps to Reproduce the Bug

```sh
node bin/idd-branch-name.mjs --title -h --number 5
```

Prints `issue/5-h` (exit 0) instead of help output or a parse error.

## Suggested fix

In `disambiguateSingleDashValues` (`src/scripts/cli-args.mts`), skip
rewriting a value token that itself exactly matches one of the spec's
own declared short (`-x`) or long (`--flag`) option forms — reserve
declared aliases before applying the generic single-dash-value
disambiguation.

## Environment

n/a — reproduces on any supported Node/OS.

Refs #1955
